name: Helping The Widows And Orphans
overview: Scripture commands God's people to show compassion and justice toward widows, orphans, and strangers, recognizing their vulnerability and God's special care for them. The law forbids oppressing or afflicting these groups and instructs believers to provide for their needs through deliberate acts of generosity, such as leaving portions of the harvest and tithes for them to partake in. This care reflects God's own character, who executes judgment on behalf of the fatherless and widows and blesses those who faithfully obey these commands.
